findings.evidence: Orbits.lean:19 'The vanishing order of a level-one modular form…'; Norm/Order.lean:16 'The general-level valence formula reads the level-one formula off the norm'; SturmBound.lean:22 lifts the level-one bound 'through the norm map' in its own file.
findings.fix: Move the lemma (and its Main-declarations bullet at lines 42-44) into the Norm layer — a new `TauCeti/NumberTheory/ModularForms/Norm/Orbits.lean` importing both `Order.Orbits` and `Norm.Order`, or into `Norm/Order.lean` with `import TauCeti.NumberTheory.ModularForms.Order.Orbits` added there — and drop the `Norm.Order` import from `Order/Orbits.lean`.
findings.issue: `finite_orbit_mk_image_setOf_orderOfVanishingAt_ne_zero` is a general-level statement (`𝒢 : Subgroup (GL (Fin 2) ℝ)`, `[𝒢.IsFiniteRelIndex 𝒮ℒ]`) proved via `ModularForm.norm 𝒮ℒ`, placed in a file whose doc (line 19) and every other declaration (lines 66, 79, 85, 104, 127, 161, 184) are level-one (`𝒮ℒ`). The general-level norm layer is `Norm/`; `SturmBound.lean` is the repo's precedent for a level-one result lifted through the norm living in its own downstream file, not in the level-one source file.

findings.evidence: Pre-PR imports of Orbits.lean were Order.OfVanishing, Modular.Orbits, FiniteZeros; grep of FiniteZeros.lean and Modular/Orbits.lean shows no Norm/ dependency, so this edge is new.
findings.fix: Remove this import together with the relocation above; the dependency then sits in the Norm-layer file where the lemma lives.
findings.issue: The added `import TauCeti.NumberTheory.ModularForms.Norm.Order` gives the level-one orbit file a new dependency on the general-level norm chain (`Norm.Order → Norm.Trace → Cusps.Basic, GaloisProd, Mathlib …NormTrace`), inherited by `Order/OrbitReduction.lean:7` and `LevelOne/FundamentalDomainBoundary/ValencePV.lean:12`, neither of which uses the new lemma.

summary: The new general-level, norm-derived lemma is appended to the level-one orbit file, dragging the whole Norm/ chain into Order/Orbits.lean and its two level-one consumers. It belongs downstream of both inputs, in the Norm/ layer, following the SturmBound.lean precedent.
